 Judgment

The Petitioner has filed this petition under Sec.166 of the M.V. Act, seeking compensation of Rs.5,00,000/- for the injuries suffered by him in a road accident dated 06.03.2022.
2.

The case of the Petitioner in brief is that:
On 06.03.2022 at about 05.30pm the petitioner was going towards Palamaner town f r o m G a n g a v a r a m t o w n b y r i d i n g a S c o o t y m o t o r c y c l e b e a r i n g Reg.No.AP-39-GJ-9706 reached near Pathuru Village, Gangavaram Mandal, Chittoor Dist.
A Maruthi Wagon R Car bearing Reg.No.KA- 51-N-6366 came from same direction at high speed in a rash and negligent manner and dashed violently against the petitioner's motorcycle.

Due to impact, the petitioner was knocked down,
sustained grievous injuries.
Immediately he was shifted to Govt. Hospital, Palamaner wherein provided first aid treatment and petitioner was referred to Arogya Clinic,
Palamaner wherein shoulder AP joint noticed and treated by operative method, took treatment as an inpatient for 15 days and thereafter he is under treatment as an outpatient.
So far he has spent Rs.50,000/- towards conveyance, food and nourishment charges.
Prior to the date of accident, he was hale and healthy, working as a Supplier in a Hotel and earning Rs.15,000/- per month.
Due to accidental injuries he has lost the income and future prospective life.
The Gangavaram Traffic Police have registered the case in Cr.No.36/2022 punishable u/Sec.279, 337 of IPC against the driver of the offending Car bearing Reg.No.KA-51-N- 6366.
The 1st respondent being the RC owner and the 2 nd respondent being the insurer of the offending vehicle are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation to the petitioner.
Hence this petition.
3. In response to notice issued by this Tribunal, the Respondents appeared through their respective counsels and filed separate written statements.
4. Objection of the Respondent No.1.
He has denied all the averments made in the petition.

He has admitted the ownership of the car and also contended that the Car was insured with the respondent No.2/Insurance company vide policy No.3428003121060085287 valid from 31.08.2021 till 30.08.2022.
The driver was holding valid DL as on the date of accident.
Hence prays for dismissal of the petition.
5. Objection of the Respondent No.2.

sentences.text: It has denied all the averments of the petition except admitting the issuance of policy in favour of the 1 st respondent in respect to the Car bearing No.KA-51-N-6366.
The petition is not maintainable for non compliance of Sec.134(c) and 158(6) of the MV Act.
The petitioner is solely responsible for the accident.
There is nonjoinder of necessary parties to the petition.
Respondent No.2 denied the involvement of the offending Car, the age, income, occupation of the petitioner and stated that the compensation claimed by the petitioner is highly exorbitant.
Therefore, prayed for dismissal of the petition against them.

6. On the basis of the above pleadings the following issues are framed:
1.

Whether the petitioner proves that, the accident took place on 06.03.2022 at about 5.30pm near Pathuru Village, Gangavaram Mandal, Chittor District, Andhra Pradesh,
due to rash and negligent driving of driver of Car bearing Reg.No.KA-51-N-6366 and in the said accident petitioner sustained injuries?
2. Whether the petitioner is entitled for compensation?
If so, what is the quantum?

From whom?
3.

What order or Award?
7. The Petitioner in order to prove his case, has examined himself as PW.1 and got marked documents as per Exs.P.1 to P.6.
On the other side, the Respondents did not examine any witness nor produced any documents.

8. Heard the arguments and perused the materials on record.
9.

On hearing both sides and perusal of the evidence on record this court answers the above issues as follows:-
Issue No.1: In the affirmative, Issue No.2: In the affirmative, Issue No.3: As per the final order, for the following:-
REASONS 10. Issue No.1:-
In order to prove that the accident occurred due to the actionable negligence on the part of the driver of the Maruthi Wagon R Car bearing Reg.No.KA-51-N-6366, the petitioner has examined himself as PW.1 by reiterating the petition averments in his chief examination affidavit and produced 4 documents as per Exs.P.1 to P.4.
During his cross-examination he has admitted that the accident took place in Andhra Pradesh and the case was registered in Andhra Pradesh.
The bike belongs to his friend Koteshwar and had insurance.
He has DL.

sentences.text: The accident occurred on 06.03.2022 and the FIR at Ex.P.1 was registered on the next day on the complaint of the petitioner's younger brother.
The sketch at Ex.P.2 shows that the Car hit behind the motorcycle on Chennai Road.
The wound Certificate at Ex.P.3 shows that the petitioner has suffered injuries in an RTA dated 06.03.2022.
The Gangavaram police have filed the charge sheet against the driver of the offending Car after investigation as per Ex.P.4.
The Respondent No.2 has contended that the accident occurred due to sole negligence of the petitioner himself.
But in order to prove the same, they have neither produced any documents nor examined any witness.

Therefore, on the basis of the evidence of PW.1 and the documents before the court Exs.P.1 to P.4, the Tribunal holds that the accident occurred due to the negligence of the driver of the offending Car bearing No.KA-51-N-6366.
Accordingly, issue No.1 is held in the affirmative.
12. Issue No.2:-
The Petitioner has further averred that on account of the accident he is suffering from simple and grievous injuries.

The Petitioner to substantiate that there is loss of income due to the accidental injuries and that he is suffering from permanent disability has not examined either the treated Doctor or any other Doctor who has got expertise in this field.
He also has not placed any disability certificate issued by the competent person to prove that he suffered permanent disability.

Therefore, in absence of evidence this Tribunal holds that the injuries sustained by the petitioner in the accident has not caused him permanent disability resulting in loss of income and accordingly the version of the petitioner in this regard is not acceptable.
Under these circumstances the petitioner is not entitled for compensation under the head of loss of future income due to disability.
However, it is pertinent to note that, the wound certificate produced as per Ex.P.3 discloses that, he has sustained grievous injuries.
Therefore, the Petitioner is entitled for compensation of Rs.50,000/- under the head of Pain and Suffering.
The Petitioner has stated that he has spent more than Rs.50,000/- medical, conveyance and nourishment expenses.
In this regard he has not produced any medical bills.
Therefore, he is not getting any amount under the head of Medical Expenses.
As mentioned above the Petitioner was treated at Arogya Clinic, Palamaner wherein he was treated for 15 days.
In this regard he has not produced discharge summary of said hospital.

But, on the basis of Wound Certificate and injuries this court deems it fit to fix Rs.50,000/- towards attendant, conveyance,
transportation and for other incidental expenses.
The total compensation comes to Rs.1,00,000/-.

13. LIABILITY:
As discussed above the Respondents have failed to prove their defence about the accident.
Therefore, the Respondents Nos.1 & 2 being the RC owner and the Insurer of the offending vehicle are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation to the Petitioner.
The Petitioner has claimed for a sum of Rs.5,00,000/- but he is entitled only for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- alongwith interest @ 6% per annum.
Therefore, the petition needs to be allowed.
Accordingly, Issue No.2 is held in the affirmative.

sentences.text: The petition is allowed with cost.

The Petitioner is entitled for compensation of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only)
along with interest @ 6% p.a. from the date of petition till the date of depositing the amount by the respondent.
The Respondent Nos.1 & 2 are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation to the petitioner.
The Respondent No.2 being the insurer of the offending vehicle shall deposit the compensation amount with interest within sixty days from the date of this award.
On deposit of compensation and interest, entire amount shall be released in favour of the Petitioner through e-payment on proper identification and due acknowledgment as per Rules.
Advocate fee is fixed at Rs.1,000/-.
Draw decree accordingly.
